== Notes ==
* Effective for spreading the burning condition with low energy fire damage spells, fire damage weapons or a [[Hound of Balthazar]] animal companion, (inflicting fire damage).
* Like all spells that cause burning, it works well with [["They're on Fire!"]].
* Frequently combined with [[Searing Flames]] to keep the target burning (as well as deal significant damage).

== Trivia ==
* Rodgort spelled backwards is [[w:Trogdor|Trogdor]], which is the name of a dragon from one of the [[w:Homestar Runner|Homestar Runner]] cartoons.
** There is another skill with the same name reference, [[Rodgort's Invocation]].
